greenLineSource.method: The western edge of the West Bank outline in public/vote-map/context.json: the outline from its northeastern corner on the Jordan River (35.554E, 32.389N) west and south to the Dead Sea shore (35.395E, 31.490N), leaving out the frontier along the Jordan River and the Dead Sea.

notes: The source's attribute table labels two polygons 'A'. The one holding Nablus, Ramallah and Jenin is Area A; the one holding Abu Dis, Taybeh and Sinjil (Area B villages) is Area B, and is stored as B here.
Hebron's H1 is stored with Area A and H2 with Area C. The Wye River nature reserve is stored with Area B.
Simplified (Douglas-Peucker, 0.0015 degrees), holes removed (the map draws C, then B, then A on top), rings under 0.15 sq km dropped, coordinates rounded to 4 decimals.
